steps.why: Re-fit model to confirm reproducibility and baseline performance.
Run performance, calibration, stability, fairness, and data quality checks.
Review legacy code for compliance with coding standards and potential errors.
Translate findings into monetary impact and customer implications.

data.rationale: We include a challenger to benchmark against a modern algorithm, slice_search to detect underperforming segments, and stress_test to evaluate robustness under perturbations. These analyses provide a comprehensive view of model performance, fairness, and resilience beyond baseline checks.
